role: Runs a non-saved HKWorkoutSession + HKLiveWorkoutBuilder on the Watch as a keep-alive during iPhone-recorded workouts, takes over a session watchOS hands back after relaunching the app (applying what the iPhone said while the hand-back was outstanding), forwards wrist HR to the iPhone over WCSession as watchHRSample, and ends the session on wrist Stop when the phone is unreachable or after 30 min of iPhone silence, publishing that it ended without the phone.
types: WatchWorkoutManager: class (NSObject, ObservableObject; MainActor by target default SWIFT_DEFAULT_ACTOR_ISOLATION=MainActor) — Watch keep-alive workout session owner
extension WatchWorkoutManager: HKWorkoutSessionDelegate — releases sessions the system ended/failed
extension WatchWorkoutManager: HKLiveWorkoutBuilderDelegate — forwards most recent HR
state: mem:WatchWorkoutManager.phoneRecordingDuringRecovery (Bool?: what the iPhone last said while a recovery was outstanding)
toplevel: Instance created and owned by WatchAppDelegate (EmuquWatch Watch App/WatchApp.swift), which WatchApp reads through its delegate adaptor. Stored-property initializers only; lastPhoneContact starts at Date().

units.does: Requests HealthKit authorization once (share workoutType, read heartRate) when health data is available; on success sets hasRequestedAuth; on error sets lastStartError to 'Apple Health authorization failed: …'.
units.entry: Called from WatchApp.wireUp in .onAppear (EmuquWatch Watch App/WatchApp.swift) and from start()'s Task.

branches.cond: hasRequestedAuth is false and HealthKit is available
branches.effect: false: return immediately (already asked, or no HealthKit — hasRequestedAuth stays false); true: request
sets lastStartError message; hasRequestedAuth stays false so a later call asks again

units.does: Start for the iPhone's workout: first marks any running session as no longer a recovered one (the iPhone is recording) and, while a recovery is outstanding, notes that the iPhone is recording (phoneRecordingDuringRecovery = true); ignores the call if a session exists or a start is pending; otherwise records the sport, clears endedWithoutPhone, marks the start pending with its sport, begins the authorization wait when auth has not been requested and none is in flight, and calls finishPendingStart (which starts at once when nothing is outstanding).

branches.effect: true: return (duplicate start from dual-channel delivery, or a recovered session kept); false: continue

units.does: Sets authorizationInFlight and runs a main-actor Task that awaits requestAuthorizationIfNeeded, clears authorizationInFlight and calls finishPendingStart.

Starts the held start once nothing it waits on is outstanding: returns unless a start is pending with no authorization request and no recovery in flight; then clears startPending and starts a session with pendingSportRaw only if none exists (a recovered one is kept).

branches.effect: false: return (cancelled by stop(), or still waiting); true: clear startPending and continue
true: startWorkoutSession(pendingSportRaw); false: nothing (a recovered session runs)

units.does: Sets recoveryPending, clears phoneRecordingDuringRecovery, and calls HKHealthStore.recoverActiveWorkoutSession; its @Sendable completion hops to the main actor with the recovered session (nil on error, which means there was none) and calls finishRecovery.
units.entry: Called from WatchAppDelegate.handleActiveWorkoutRecovery when watchOS relaunches the app to hand back its active workout session.

units.does: Clears recoveryPending and takes (and clears) phoneRecordingDuringRecovery. When there is a recovered session and none is running, adopts it (as the iPhone's workout's session when the iPhone said it is recording during the wait, else as a recovered one the iPhone has not asked for) and, when the iPhone said during the wait it is not recording or stopped, stops it at once; otherwise ends the recovered one (if any). Then calls finishPendingStart so a held start proceeds or is satisfied by the adopted session.

branches.effect: true: adopt(recovered, askedForByPhone: phone said recording); false: recovered?.end() (a duplicate beside a running session, or nothing)

branches.cond: the iPhone said during the wait it is not recording (or stopped)

units.does: Takes over a recovered session: gets its associated workout builder, sets this manager as delegate of both, stores them as session/builder, sets sessionWasRecovered unless the iPhone asked for it (askedForByPhone), and starts the phone-silence watch.

Called when the iPhone reports not recording with no transition: while a recovery is outstanding, records it for finishRecovery (phoneRecordingDuringRecovery = false); then stops the session only when it is a recovered one the iPhone has not asked for; otherwise does nothing more.
Builds the configuration for the sport and begins the session; success clears lastStartError, failure records it via noteStartFailure.
Returns an HKWorkoutConfiguration with activityType/locationType from activityAndLocation(forSport:).
Maps the iPhone Sport raw value to HKWorkoutActivityType and location.

Creates HKWorkoutSession + associated HKLiveWorkoutBuilder with HKLiveWorkoutDataSource, sets delegates, stores both, startActivity(now), beginCollection(now) with an @Sendable completion that, when collection did not begin and an error was given, hops to the main actor and reports it through noteStartFailure; then starts the phone-silence watch.

branches.cond: collection did not begin and an error was given (completion)
branches.effect: true: noteStartFailure(error) on the main actor; false: nothing

units.does: Sets lastStartError to a localized 'Wrist HR fallback not started: <error>…' message on MainActor.

Idempotent stop: clears startPending, endedForPhoneSilence and sessionWasRecovered, records a stop while a recovery is outstanding (phoneRecordingDuringRecovery = false, so finishRecovery stops the session handed back), cancels the silence task; if a session exists, nils session/builder, ends the session and discards the builder's workout (no callbacks; nothing saved).

branches.effect: false: return after clearing flags (second stop is a no-op); true: tear down, end and discard

units.does: Wrist Stop: when the iPhone is not reachable (WatchMessageDecoding.endsSessionOnWristStop) ends the Watch session with stop() and sets endedWithoutPhone; otherwise does nothing.
units.entry: Called from the Watch End button in WatchLiveView (PauseStopScreen.endButton), and from WatchSessionManager.failLiveControlRequest when a live End failed.

branches.effect: false: return (phone's stop will end it); true: stop(), endedWithoutPhone = true

units.does: Once per app life subscribes (async values of $messagesReceived minus initial) and calls notePhoneContact(phoneRecording: sessionManager.isRecording) for each iPhone message.
units.entry: Called from WatchApp.wireUp in .onAppear (EmuquWatch Watch App/WatchApp.swift).

branches.effect: notePhoneContact per message until the stream ends

units.does: Stamps lastPhoneContact=now; if the session had been ended for phone silence, clears that flag and restarts it with the previous sport when the iPhone is still recording.

branches.effect: false: return after stamping contact; true: clear flag and continue
true: start(sportRaw: sessionSportRaw); false: no restart

units.does: Cancels any previous silence task, resets lastPhoneContact to now and starts a Task running checkForPhoneSilence.
Loop: sleep phoneSilenceCheckInterval (60 s) then endIfPhoneSilent until it returns true; a CancellationError from sleep ends the loop.

branches.effect: loops every 60 s while the session runs and the phone is not silent; exits when it ended or there is no session
return silently — stop() or a restart cancelled the watch

units.does: Returns true when there is no session; otherwise if the last phone contact is more than 30 min ago (phoneSilenceExceeded) calls stop(), sets endedForPhoneSilence and endedWithoutPhone and returns true; else false.

branches.effect: false: return true (nothing to watch); true: continue
false: return false (keep watching); true: stop(), endedForPhoneSilence = true, endedWithoutPhone = true, return true

units.does: Sends {type: watchHRSample, heartRate: bpm} via WCSession.sendMessage when reachable; no error handler.

branches.effect: false: return, sample dropped; true: send

units.does: HKWorkoutSessionDelegate state change: when the session reaches .ended or .stopped, forgets it on MainActor.
HKWorkoutSessionDelegate failure: forgets the session on MainActor; error itself not surfaced.
If the given session is the current one, nils session and builder so later start() calls are not blocked.

branches.effect: false: return (already torn down by stop()); true: release references

units.does: HKLiveWorkoutBuilderDelegate event callback; no-op.
HKLiveWorkoutBuilderDelegate data callback: when heart rate was collected, reads the most recent HR statistic in count/min, rounds it and forwards it to the iPhone on MainActor.
units.entry: HealthKit HKLiveWorkoutBuilderDelegate callback as samples are collected.

branches.effect: false: nothing sent; true: forwardLatestHR(rounded bpm)
